scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && uv --directory backend run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && uv --directory backend run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && uv --directory backend run mypy
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && uv --directory backend run pytest --cov=backend --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && uv --directory backend build
